lead_raw_text:
The cubic phase Dy8Ge4Pb4 (Dy2GePb) crystallizes in space group F-43m (No. 216), with 16 atoms in the unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows Dy centers with 14 neighbors (6 Ge, 8 Pb) in a close-packed-like local arrangement, while Ge and Pb each have 9 neighbors (6 Dy plus 3 of the other element). The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner- and edge-sharing between Dy and Ge polyhedra, and corner-sharing between Ge and Pb polyhedra.
